reviewer: root AI visual review, not official ground truth or human expert annotation
evidence: All twelve overview and contact sheets viewed; contact sheets were centered using author accident metadata, so this is NOT blind to the author-selected time window.
entry_definition: First wheel touching ego driving corridor or its extension, not first screen appearance.
interval_policy: Intervals below are coarse visual hypotheses for independent reconciliation. None is an exact ground-truth label. Physical contact is often hidden by the hood or outside frame.
